sales_description:
UnoDent Aspirating Cartridge Syringe, designed for the administration of local anesthetics. Features a breech-loading mechanism for easy cartridge insertion and a rotatable barrel for visibility of the cartridge. Made of durable stainless steel/chromium-plated brass.

Type: Aspirating Syringe
Capacity: 1.8ml / 2.2ml Cartridges
Material: Stainless Steel / Plated Brass

Monoject Dental Needles 27 Gauge Long (Yellow). Features an ultra-sharp, tri-beveled anti-coring tip for minimizing patient discomfort. The polypropylene hub is color-coded for easy identification and features a self-threading design for secure attachment.

Gauge: 27G Long
Color: Yellow
Features: Tri-beveled, Anti-coring, Sterile

Monoject Dental Needles 30 Gauge Extra-Short (Blue). Designed specifically for intraligamentary injections. Features a tri-beveled, anti-coring stainless steel cannula for smooth penetration.

Gauge: 30G Extra-Short
Color: Blue
Use: Intraligamentary Injection

Needle Gard II (Conta-Guard) by RØNVIG Dental. An autoclavable needle recapping device designed to prevent needle-stick injuries during one-handed recapping. Compatible with standard dental syringes.

Type: Needle Safety Device
Feature: Autoclavable
Application: Infection Control / Safety

Monoject Dental Needles 30 Gauge Short (Blue). Sterile, disposable dental needles with a tri-beveled point and anti-coring design. Polypropylene hub fits standard dental syringes.

Gauge: 30G Short
Color: Blue
Features: Sterile, Tri-beveled

Ligmaject II Intraligamental Syringe. A pistol-grip style pressure syringe designed for intraligamentary anesthesia. Delivers a precise 0.2ml dose per trigger squeeze. Autoclavable.

Type: Intraligamental Syringe
Dose: 0.2ml per click
Style: Pistol/Gun Grip

Lignospan Standard (Lidocaine HCl 2% with Epinephrine 1:100,000). A sterile, isotonic solution for local dental anesthesia. Provides profound anesthesia with a rapid onset.

Active: Lidocaine HCl 2%, Epinephrine 1:100,000
Volume: 1.7ml Cartridge
Color Code: Red Band

Transcoject Painless Steel Injection Needles 25 Gauge Short. Features a unique siliconized, three-edge lancet grinding for virtually painless penetration. Threaded hub ensures secure fit.

Gauge: 25G Short
Color: Red
Features: Siliconized, 3-Edge Lancet

DEHP Syringe Cartridge Self-Aspirating 2.2ml ECO. Lightweight, side-loading syringe with an automatic aspiration mechanism. Chrome-plated brass construction for durability.

Type: Self-Aspirating Syringe
Capacity: 2.2ml
Mechanism: Passive Aspiration

Monoject 412 Curved Tip Utility Syringe. A 12mL non-sterile syringe with a tapered curved tip, ideal for irrigation, impression material delivery, and site cleaning.

Capacity: 12mL
Tip: Curved Tapered
Use: Irrigation / Utility

N-Tralig Barrel Cap 30D. A 30-degree angled barrel hub adapter for the N-Tralig Intraligamental Syringe. Facilitates access to difficult-to-reach injection sites.

Type: Syringe Adapter
Angle: 30 Degree
Compatibility: N-Tralig Syringe

Septoject Standard Dental Needles 30 Gauge Short. Triple-beveled, polished, and siliconized cannula for smooth tissue penetration. Sterile and designated for single use.

Gauge: 30G Short
Features: Triple-bevel, Siliconized
Pack: 100/Box

Septocaine (Articaine HCl 4% with Epinephrine 1:200,000). An amide local anesthetic providing fast onset and deep anesthesia. 2.2ml cartridges.

Active: Articaine HCl 4%, Epinephrine 1:200,000
Volume: 2.2ml Cartridge
Use: Local/Infiltration/Block Anesthesia

Vivid Irrigating Syringe 3cc with attached 27 Gauge Yellow needle. Designed for precise irrigation of root/endo canals, periodontal pockets, and surgical sites. Side-vented needle tip.

Capacity: 3cc
Needle: 27G Yellow
Use: Endo/Perio Irrigation

Carbocaine 3% (Mepivacaine HCl) Plain. An anesthetic solution without vasoconstrictor, suitable for patients where epinephrine is contraindicated. 1.7ml cartridges.

Active: Mepivacaine HCl 3%
Formulation: Plain (No Epinephrine)
Use: Local Anesthesia

Medesy Intraligamental Syringe (Pen Style). Compact stainless steel pressure syringe for intraligamentary anesthesia. Delivers 0.2ml per dose with a positive ratchet action.

Type: Intraligamental Syringe
Style: Pen/Compact
Dose: 0.2ml/click
